title: Penalty Season – Free Penalty Shootout Football Game with a League
description: Play Penalty Season free in your browser: swipe to shoot, tap to save, win penalty shootouts and lead your animal team through a full league season.
body: Swipe to shoot, tap to save. Every match is a penalty shootout of five kicks each, then sudden death, and it lasts one to two minutes.

Between matches you run the club: a ten-match season in a league of cute animal teams, a league table, coins to upgrade your five strikers and your keeper, and team morale that rises with every win. Finish first to go up a division.
No text, no sign-up, and it works on phones, tablets, Chromebooks and desktops. Your season is saved automatically.
New here? Read how to play and the tips to score and save more.

title: How to Play Penalty Season – Shooting, Saving and the League
description: Penalty Season controls: swipe to aim, swipe speed for power, a curved swipe for curl, tap the goal to dive. Plus how points, the table and promotion work.
body: Shooting. Swipe up from the ball toward the goal. The direction of the swipe aims the shot. The speed of the swipe sets the power: a slow swipe rolls along the grass and is easy to save, a fast one flies into the top corner, and a very fast one sails over the bar.

Curl. Bend your swipe and the ball bends too: it starts out toward the side your finger bowed and curls back to where you aimed. Keepers read the first part of the flight, so a curled shot fools them more often.

Saving. When the other team shoots, tap the spot in the goal where you want your keeper to dive (on a computer, the arrow keys also work). Just before the kick the striker glances at a corner: that is usually where he will shoot. Dive too early and he may change his mind.

The shootout. Five kicks each, you shoot first. It ends early when one team can no longer be caught; if it is level after five, it goes to sudden death. The dots at the top show every kick: green for a goal, red for a miss.

The league. Six teams play each other twice: ten matchdays. A win in the first five kicks is worth 3 points, a win in sudden death 2, a loss in sudden death 1 and a loss in five kicks 0. Level teams are separated by goal difference, then goals scored, then the matches between them. Finish first to be promoted; there are three divisions.
Your squad. Five strikers with power and accuracy, and a keeper with reflexes. Spend the coins you win on upgrades from the shirt button in the season screen.

title: Penalty Season Tips: Score More Penalties and Save More Shots
description: Practical tips for Penalty Season: when to shoot, how hard to swipe, how to curl the ball, how to read the striker's glance and how to spend your coins.
body: Shoot when the keeper leans. The keeper sways along his line before every kick. Swipe toward the side he is leaving and he has further to dive.

Firm, not wild. A quick, confident flick is ideal. If your shots keep flying over the bar, swipe a little slower; if they are saved easily, swipe a little faster. Upgrading power makes hard shots safer.
Curl it in higher divisions. Better keepers react faster. A curved swipe sends them the wrong way for the first half of the flight.
Aim inside the posts. Shots right on the post often hit it. Accuracy upgrades shrink the spread, so you can aim closer to the corners later on.
Watch the glance, then wait a moment. The striker's look at a corner is honest most of the time in the first division and bluffs more often later. Diving right as he kicks beats diving early.
Tap where the ball will cross the line. Your keeper dives to the exact spot you tap, high or low. Low corners are saved with a low tap.
Upgrade the keeper early. Reflexes make every dive faster and longer, and saves earn extra coins.
Keep the winning run going. Team morale rises with wins and slightly improves aim and reach. Sudden-death wins still count, so never give up a level shootout.

title: Penalty Season FAQ
description: Answers about Penalty Season: is it free, does it save, does it work on phones and Chromebooks, are the teams real, how promotion and the retake work.
body: Is it free? Yes, it is free to play in the browser, with no download and no account.
Does it save my season? Yes. Your league table, squad, coins, kits and balls are stored in your browser (or in your account on game portals that offer it).
Does it work on phones and Chromebooks? Yes, with touch or mouse, in landscape or portrait. On a computer you can also dive with the arrow keys.
Are the teams real? No. Every club is a fictional team of cartoon animals with its own colours and badge. There are no real clubs, players, leagues or logos.
How do I get promoted? Finish first after ten matchdays. There are three divisions; win the top one to lift the title, then defend it against tougher rivals.
What is the video button after a miss? On some game portals you can watch an optional video to retake one missed penalty per match, or to double the coins of a match. It is never required.
Can I turn the music off? Yes, with the speaker button in the top right corner.

title: Penalty Season for Schools and Kids – Safe, Short, No Sign-up
description: Penalty Season is a short, text-free football game that runs on school Chromebooks: no chat, no purchases, no account, matches of one to two minutes.
h1: Penalty Season for classrooms and kids
body: Penalty Season has no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data. A match lasts one to two minutes, which makes it an easy reward between tasks.
There is no text in the game, only numbers and icons, so it works the same for children who are still learning to read and for students of any language.
It quietly practises numbers: the league table uses points, wins, losses and goal difference with plus and minus signs, and the squad screen is about saving coins and choosing what to improve first.
Every team is made of friendly cartoon animals; there are no real clubs or players. It runs in the browser on Chromebooks, tablets and phones and loads in a couple of seconds (about 1.7 MB).
